rule: MMR-261 (RT-37): every fwg.exe build a campaign may cast with ships in the package, by SHA-256, at Producers/<sha256>/fwg.exe (Modules/MNBL.ProceduralWorld/Producers, Git LFS: MSVC output is not byte-reproducible, so a build is kept, never rebuilt). A campaign records the build that generated its world (the bundle's source.producer.binarySha256) and casts only with that build; a new cast is refused only when that build is missing here or its bytes differ; stored mutations always load (they replay without a producer). Entries are append-only: a re-pin adds the new build (tests/check_producer_lock.py requires the pinned build to be listed and present); none is ever removed. Builds before FWGC++ 0ae1f3e have no apply command, and their worlds no longer load (the map epic 2 clean break), so none is listed.
